title: Client interop assessment: language coverage, auth-handshake patterns, and streaming ergonomics for enterprise SDKs
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Context: Over the past quarter we have an increasing set of enterprise requests that are blocked by SDK client ergonomics: missing language bindings (Go/Ruby/Node variants of long-poll/stream client), token rotation and resumable-stream handshake patterns, and networking/SSO failure modes behind corporate proxies. This ticket creates a repeatable triage + prioritization framework to convert incoming non-bug SDK requests into delivery work or documented mitigations.

Goals:
- Define an interoperability matrix that maps languages -> recommended auth handshake (API key, bearer + refresh, SSO/SAML exchange, mTLS) -> streaming model (resumable, chunked streaming, reconnect strategy).
- Establish prioritization rubric (signal weighting) that balances enterprise safety, frequency, engineering cost, and operational risk.
- Produce an intake template and quick-run playbook for Solutions/Support to capture minimal reproducible environment for triage.
- Deliver a first-pass roadmap of high-value SDK items (top 6) with owners and rough estimates.

Proposed prioritization rubric (example weights):
- Customer severity (high/medium/low) -> weight 30%
- Number of customers affected / pipeline potential -> 25%
- Security or compliance requirement (SSO, KMS, audit) -> 20%
- Engineering effort (est) -> -10% (penalty)
- Maintenance footprint (L2/L3 support) -> -10% (penalty)
- Strategic gap (language parity vs competitors) -> 15%
Use a 100-point normalized score to rank backlog items.

Deliverables:
1) Client Interop Matrix (CSV + Confluence): languages x auth patterns x streaming ergonomics x recommended SDK surface.
2) Intake template (Support form + Slack shortcut) listing environment, sample replay, network topology, TLS/Proxy/SAML details.
3) Prioritization spreadsheet with historical request signals and computed scores.
4) Roadmap doc: top 6 tickets with owners, estimates, and target release tags.

Success criteria:
- Intake template adopted by Support (>=90% of new SDK enterprise requests use it within 2 sprints).
- Top 3 prioritized SDK changes have implementation plans and assigned ENG owners within cycle.
- 50% reduction in back-and-forth clarifying questions on new requests measured across next 8 weeks.

Notes / constraints:
- Some enterprise fixes are mitigations (docs + sample configs) rather than full SDK work; include lift estimates for both.
- Coordinate with Security for SSO/KMS review early to avoid rework.
- For streaming ergonomics we need ENG input on reconnect/backoff and how runtime will expose resumable tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Draft client interop matrix uploaded to Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PM/pages/Client-Interop-Matrix
Intake template created and a Slack shortcut added to #support-sdk
Prioritization spreadsheet populated with last 12 months of inbound requests and scored
Roadmap with owners and estimates published and reviewed by ENG and Design
